desc: Ideation: feasibility predicate 2*A[i] <= A[N-K+i] for all i in [0,K), monotone in K; binary search or half-split greedy both viable.
Write the complete Python solution: read N and list A from stdin, binary search K in [0, N//2] with feasibility check `all(2*A[i] <= A[N-K+i] for i in range(K))`, print the maximum feasible K.
Verify edge cases mentally: N=2 with A=[1,2] -> 1; all equal sizes -> 0; N odd; confirm O(N log N) fits N=5e5.
